activity_summary: Near the middle of the day a hired rider who had passed at a hand-gallop was leading the horse lame. Hobbins did not turn his head. He said he has known three that rode post, and has outlived them, and that soft and steady has the miles. You did not offer the spare. The rider blamed the shoe. You walked on.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Saw the lame horse, and kept the pace.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Refused the glance, and kept the three he has outlived.

facets.activity: Left the lame horse to its shoe

quotes.speaker: thomas_hobbins
quotes.text: I've known three that rode post, and I've outlived them.

quotes.speaker: thomas_hobbins
quotes.text: Soft and steady has the miles.
